mainEntity.name: How much does a Range Rover P440e engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full reconditioned or rebuilt Range Rover P440e engine typically costs between £4,500 and £10,000 for the unit itself, depending on the level of rebuild.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of cooling system failure in a Range Rover P440e?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early detection is critical to preventing catastrophic damage to your AJ20P6 engine. Look for unexplained coolant loss, overheating warnings on the dashboard, or a sweet smell from the engine bay. The PHEV system may also limit electric mode availability if thermal management is compromised.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Range Rover P440e?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely, given the high retained values of the L460 PHEV Range Rover lineup. A rebuilt AJ20P6 engine with upgraded water pumps and cooling components can extend the vehicle's life significantly. For vehicles valued over £80,000, a warranted reconditioned engine protects your investment far better than a cheap used unit.

mainEntity.name: Does the P440e engine replacement include the high-voltage hybrid battery?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the engine replacement covers the AJ20P6 internal combustion unit only. The high-voltage battery is a separate component. However, our vetted specialists are trained to safely disconnect, protect, and reintegrate the hybrid system during the engine swap.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Range Rover P440e engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A straightforward supply and fit of a reconditioned AJ20P6 engine typically takes 3 to 5 days at a specialist workshop. This allows time for high-voltage system safety protocols, proper bedding-in procedures, ECU calibration, and a thorough road test.

commonProblems.h2: Range Rover P440e Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Range Rover P440e is celebrated for its seamless blend of electric torque and refined inline-six performance. The AJ20P6 / 306PS 3.0L Ingenium petrol engine is the core internal combustion unit driving replacement demand for this variant. Rebuilt engines supplied through EnginesMarket include upgraded components, such as revised water pumps and cooling system seals, addressing the original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Cooling System & Water Pump Failure - Why the Range Rover P440e AJ20P6 Requires Attention
problems.rootCause: Plastic water pump impellers or housing cracks can lead to coolant loss and subsequent overheating, a risk slightly exacerbated by the additional thermal management demands of the PHEV battery cooling system.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace water pump, flush system, and inspect PHEV thermal management seals.
repairOptions.longevity: Highly recommended as preventative maintenance to avoid catastrophic overheating.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if there is severe overheating damage, warped heads, or you want long-term reliability.

problems.recommendation: If your Range Rover P440e is exhibiting early signs of coolant loss or minor boost irregularities, a preventative specialist service is a cost-effective solution. However, if the engine has suffered severe overheating or internal damage, a full reconditioned replacement is the most reliable long-term investment to preserve the vehicle's performance and value.

problems.h4: Turbocharger & Crossover Pipe Leaks - Why the Range Rover P440e AJ20P6 Loses Performance
problems.rootCause: Thermal cycling can cause plastic coolant crossover pipes to become brittle and leak, while turbocharger seals may wear over time, leading to boost loss or coolant ingestion.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace crossover pipes, inspect turbocharger seals, and verify boost pressure.
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught early and there is no secondary internal engine damage.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if coolant ingestion has caused internal damage or the engine has high mileage.
